method: Manual substantive section-by-section comparison by the declared AI agent under participant direction; not an automatic file mapping.

items.notes: X京张 / X JINGZHANG and the co-development claim are equivalent.
Both versions lead with the city as an AI development environment.
Residents, developers, universities, industry and daily life retain the same roles.

items.zh_section: TEST / RELEASE / USE / RETURN质量底盘
items.en_section: TEST / RELEASE / USE / RETURN quality foundation
items.notes: Conditions and hierarchy match; neither version presents package PASS as field approval.

items.zh_section: 90日准备评估窗口、D1-D14运行、第180日可选复核
items.en_section: 90-day readiness-review window, D1-D14 operation, optional day-180 review
items.notes: Both languages now use one time model and reject 90 days as a field-operating duration.

items.zh_section: 面积、比例、场景、角色、日期和阈值
items.en_section: Areas, ratios, scenes, roles, dates and thresholds
items.notes: Tables and inline quantities were compared section by section; units retain provisional/target qualifiers.
Both languages now distinguish the 14-day controlled operating shift from the 90-day readiness and review window.
Source and uncertainty states remain equivalent.
Both versions limit geometry to concept relations and package recomputation.

items.zh_section: 图件顺序、位置、图注和生成式标识
items.en_section: Figure order, placement, captions and generative notices
items.notes: All 25 report figures map by position; realistic-image captions carry equivalent limitations.

items.zh_section: 风险、审批和现场验证措辞
items.notes: No version upgrades concept evidence to approval or implementation.

items.zh_section: 生成服务、模型unknown、日期、条款和再分发边界
items.en_section: Generation service, unknown model, date, terms and redistribution boundary
items.notes: The asset-level disclosure is substantively equivalent and avoids guessing the model.

items.zh_section: 实施阶段、14日运行、90/180日检查点
items.notes: Readiness, operation, review and restoration are distinct in both versions.

items.zh_section: 无AI等价服务、匿名异议与无障碍
items.en_section: Non-AI equivalence, anonymous objection and accessibility
items.notes: Public rights and role responsibilities match.

items.zh_section: RETURN触发、撤出、复原与新任务
items.en_section: RETURN trigger, withdrawal, restoration and new task
items.notes: The physical and record actions are equivalent.
